verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents Computer as an agent you can hand complex, multi-step work to. It browses (including login-gated pages), runs code in a Linux sandbox, drives a cloud browser and returns structured results [perplexity-docs-5, perplexity-docs-17, perplexity-docs-29, perplexity-docs-30, perplexity-docs-38]. Deep Research and Labs [perplexity-docs-8, perplexity-docs-10] reinforce the claim. However, a hands-on user report says Computer often fails to trigger from the UI and that sessions frequently stall without returning an answer [perplexity-comm-7], which directly contradicts the 'returns for my review' part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of background/asynchronous execution with notification on completion, a documented review or approval step for results, and independent evidence that delegated tasks reliably complete.
